evidence.claim: The consciousness prediction-registry repository artifact satisfies its checked-in preregistration contract and received independent exact-head agent review plus a successful pinned local-model review.
evidence.method: Pull request 119 ran typecheck, the full test suite, strategy verification, proposal review, exact-head independent agent review 4849079054, and pinned local-model workflow run 30859173640 before merge as db0df364758917e3fe48b6111afce78cf2625f01.
limitations: This evidence verifies a repository preregistration artifact and its review provenance; it does not report a human-subject experiment, establish that any person or AI system is conscious, or validate or falsify an entire theory of consciousness.

The prediction interpretations remain source-limited and require theory-proponent adjudication, institutional ethics approval, informed consent, and a genuinely access-separated blinded workflow before execution.

Because agents commit as the single owner, GitHub records independent review 4849079054 as a COMMENT by the owner account rather than platform APPROVED state; independence is supplied by the separate exact-head agent session and its recorded rationale, as authorized by repository policy.
